whole.title: whole
whole.explanation: The whole is the original amount represented by 100%.
whole.guidance: Identify what the percentage is of before choosing a calculation.

percentage-calculation.title: Choose the calculation
percentage-calculation.explanation: Percent means out of 100. A percentage can be written as a fraction or a decimal multiplier.
percentage-calculation.guidance: For a percentage of an amount, divide the percentage by 100 and multiply by the amount.

percentage-change.title: requested amount
percentage-change.explanation: The percentage part, the new amount and the percentage change are different quantities.
percentage-change.guidance: For an increase or decrease, add or subtract the change. To find percentage change, divide the change by the original amount and multiply by 100.
examples: £50 increased by 20% rises by £10 to £60. From £50 to £60, the percentage change is 10 ÷ 50 × 100 = 20%.
